description: Complete workflow to package, upload, and deploy a local project

application_id.description: Existing application ID to redeploy to

directory.description: Path to project directory. Defaults to current working directory.

name.description: Application name. Defaults to folder name for new apps.

password.description: Visitor password to gate the site behind (6-128 characters). Omit for a public site. On a redeploy the existing setting is kept unless this is given.

name: upload-and-deploy
